method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 哈蒂在笔记本新的一页写下莉娅的名字，并在下面记下“谢瑞尔 对质？”，打算下次交谈时问她。
facts.anchor: On a new page in her notebook, Hattie writes Leah’s name and beneath it Cheryl confrontation?

facts.fact: 哈蒂播放了另一个标注为 Jane Everson——达斯汀·赖滕邻居的访谈。
facts.anchor: This one is labeled Jane Everson—Dustin Reiten neighbor.

facts.fact: 简说入室盗窃发生在夏天，第一批被 burglar 的 Earls 一家去了欧洲。
facts.anchor: the Earls—they were the first to get burgled—were in Europe.

facts.fact: 简说达斯汀是入室盗窃的元凶，他是 Earls 家的朋友、知道安保密码，所以警报没响。
facts.anchor: he was friends with the Earls’ son and knew the security code, that’s why the system hadn’t been tripped.

facts.fact: 伊林请简称呼他的名字罗斯。
facts.anchor: I will. And please call me Ross.

facts.fact: 简说艾丽西亚十八岁离家、先酗酒后吸毒，跳楼时不超过二十二岁。
facts.anchor: She couldn’t have been more than twenty-two when she jumped off a balcony in Chicago.

facts.fact: 哈蒂回忆起多年前她和艾德、汤米一起安慰达斯汀时自己流泪的情景。
facts.anchor: Recalls her own tears as she and Ed and Tommy consoled him.

facts.fact: 简说达斯汀的父母赔了一千美元，尽管他只拿了食品储藏室里的几样零食。
facts.anchor: They offered me a thousand dollars if you can believe it, even though he hadn’t taken a thing except a few snacks from the pantry.

facts.fact: 简说那晚她回家发现达斯汀时，他正睡在她的床上。
facts.anchor: He was sleeping in my bed.
